AY_Sc_min.note: F1.1's transcription of Akita and Yoshida's Table II

v3_eq5_ode_gap.note: two routes to E5 (closed form, DOP853 integration of E2 and E4); no input moves them apart

v3_ls_quad_gap.note: two routes to the E10a rate (stationarity root, quadrature plus minimisation)

v3_dead_ssr_quad_gap.note: two routes to the E10d sum of squares (closed form, quadrature)

v3_eq5_at_zero.note: E5 is 0 at t = 0 for any rates (the sensor and the liquid start at zero)

v3_eq5_slope_at_zero.note: dE5/dt = A k - B ks = 0 at t = 0 for any rates

v3_CLS_numeric_gap.note: the closed form is the minimiser of the fixed-slope sum of squares

v3_slope_polyfit_gap.note: two least-squares routes to one slope

v3_AY_factor_gap.note: the shortcut is the full correlation divided by its water value, for any constants

r3_n_series.note: number of digitised series with five or more markers
